items.html: A right-arm seamer, Jaskaran Singh took three wickets on List-A debut for Punjab against Haryana in 2009, before making his first-class debut, for India A against Yorkshire, the next year. Jaskaran had a forgettable game, conceding 77 runs for no wickets in 22 overs. His first-class debut came after six matches for Deccan Chargers in IPL 2010 in which he took six wickets.

Jaskaran only made sporadic appearances for Punjab in domestic cricket after his stint with Deccan Chargers. His first-class average and T20 economy rate read 54.16 and 8.09 runs per over when he was bought by Rising Pune Super Giants for INR 10 lakh at the IPL 2016 player auction.
ESPNcricinfo staff
